data.name: Gridiron Masters '98
data.detailed_description:
PRESENTATION

Gridiron Masters '98 simulates the sport of football and presents it to you in a sports network style. The bold colors and unforgettable design let you peak into a football world that encompasses 120 college teams in 10 conferences and 36 pro teams in the NFA. Enter a football world visually set in the 90's. The big pads, the neck rolls, waffle sole cleats, teal colored turf and larger than life sports personalities! Immerse yourself in the football world!

-Period accurate music!

-Voiced show hosts!

-Unforgettable design!

FOOTBALL WORLD

College and pro, fully simulated in one game!

-120 college teams (10 conferences)

-36 pro teams

-Completely playable

-Fully simulated team histories

-Start career in 1970-1990

-Job offers

-Unlimited world generation

-Generated character avatars

-Fully logged histories for all characters and teams

TEAM MANAGEMENT

Team management is very light and quick which keeps things moving along. Tasks revolve around acquiring players and coaches with uncertain information.

-Draft board

-Simple free Agency

-Drafting

-Simple recruiting

-Transfers

-Offensive and defensive coordinator hiring

TV SHOWS

Keep up to date on events, news, scores and controversies with CSPN SportsZone! Watch as the show hosts layout the scores, stats and game analysis. So grab some pizza or whatever your pleasure is and watch the show! Don't forget the remote!

-Customizable weekly recaps

-Host discussions

-Game stories such as streaks, upsets, stat lines, new coaches, breakout players, close games, blowouts and more!

-More to come such as coach hires/fires, draft previews/reviews, season previews, playoff rankings, player/coach spotlight, coach/player interviews and more!

data.short_description: Gridiron Masters '98 is an American Football presentation sim that places you in an alternate universe that encompasses college and pro football. Create your coach and see where their career takes them while looking through the lens of the late 90s.
